svg.title: Singleton
svg.desc: Singleton. Guarantee one instance with a global access point, and why injecting one shared instance usually serves that need better. Step 1, Three pools by accident: Each call site runs new ConnectionPool(): three pools, 30 connections where 10 were planned. Step 2, One instance, one way in: Private constructor; getInstance() creates the pool on the first call and returns it ever after. Step 3, The async trap: Async creation: two calls both see no pool and open two. Store the promise before awaiting it. Step 4, Costs, and the alternative: One per process, not per system: 4 replicas open 40 connections. Usually better: inject one pool.
